question.problem:
Which of the following determinants are equal to $0?$

$$
|A|=|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & \sqrt{3} \\ \sqrt[5]{2} & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|,\,|B|=|\begin{aligned}1 & \sqrt{2} & 4 \\ 0 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}|,\,|C|=|\begin{aligned}1 & \sqrt{2} & 4 \\ 2 & 3 & 8 \\ 1 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}|
$$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the given determinants in turn.

- The matrix $A$ has a zero row: 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & \sqrt{3} \\ \sqrt[5]{2} & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

As a result, $|A|=0.$

- The matrix $B$ is a triangular matrix, hence 

$$
|B|=1\cdot 3\cdot 4=12\ne 0.
$$

- The matrix $C$ has proportional columns: 

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & \sqrt{2} & 4 \\ 2 & 3 & 8 \\ 1 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

As a result, $|C|=0.$

Therefore, only $|A|$ and $|C|$ are equal to $0.$
